observations: Actually viewed original300x250 and4x. Portuguese single call-to-action: Toque no Quadro para Ver Sua Verdadeira Personalidade.
quadro refers to framed picture, not mirror; personalidade means personality, not physical appearance. No brand, prices, conditions, publisher or other writing found.
Gold heavy serif centered right column, short dark shadow. Original portrait/frame/street protected as entire left182 columns. Local plaster background approximated from observed blank wall.
Source and translation independently checked. Bilingual configurations share actual cleaned background and individual font/hash inputs.
Current reproduction input is archived normalized PNG; original_sha256 here refers to that actual input, not the historical JPEG.
